run_benchmark_mem_eff_attention: run the xformers memory-efficient attention benchmark script with CLI arguments to measure forward and backward pass performance
test_mem_eff_attention_fw: test the mem_eff_attention_fw function that benchmarks forward pass of memory-efficient attention across multiple ops like flash, cutlass, and ck
test_mem_eff_attention_bw: test the mem_eff_attention_bw function that benchmarks backward pass of memory-efficient attention across multiple ops like flash, cutlass, and ck
create_tensors_for_attention: create tensors for attention benchmarking with shape_q, Hkv, dtype, and requires_grad options for qkv, q, k, v tensors
run_benchmark_omit_forward: run the xformers attention benchmark with --omit-forward flag to skip forward pass and only measure backward pass performance
